TS7026: No JSX types
  at main.tsx:2:10

    1 | export function Hello() {
  > 2 |   return <p>Hello</p>;
                 ^^^
    3 | }

  The JSX runtime's types (its `JSX` namespace) didn't load: the runtime doesn't resolve (see TS2875), or `compilerOptions.jsxImportSource` is not set.

  Fix: Set `"jsx": "react-jsx"` and `"jsxImportSource": "denext"` in deno.json `compilerOptions`, and map the runtime in `imports`.

  Original (deno check):
  │ TS7026 [ERROR]: JSX element implicitly has type 'any' because no interface 'JSX.IntrinsicElements' exists.
  │   return <p>Hello</p>;
  │          ~~~
  │     at file:///app/main.tsx:2:10

TS2875: The JSX runtime "preact/jsx-runtime" doesn't resolve
  at main.tsx:2:10

    1 | export function Hello() {
  > 2 |   return <p>Hello</p>;
                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^
    3 | }

  `compilerOptions.jsxImportSource` is "preact", so every JSX tag imports "preact/jsx-runtime", and nothing maps it.

  Fix: Add "preact" to deno.json `imports` (`denext add npm:preact`), or set `"jsxImportSource": "denext"`.

  Original (deno check):
  │ TS2875 [ERROR]: This JSX tag requires the module path 'preact/jsx-runtime' to exist, but none could be found. Make sure you have types for the appropriate package installed.
  │   return <p>Hello</p>;
  │          ~~~~~~~~~~~~
  │     at file:///app/main.tsx:2:10
